name: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar Municipal Corporation
headquarters: Main Building, Town Hall, behind Head Post Office, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra 431001
description: Formerly Aurangabad Municipal Corporation. The corporation dates its municipal council to 1936 and elevation to municipal corporation to 1982. The 2025–26 election covered 29 electoral wards and 115 seats.
